title: Stackdriver

fields.name: google_service_credentials
fields.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud credentials JSON file

fields.name: service_account_email
fields.description: Account email associated to the service.

fields.name: service_account_secret
fields.description: Private key content associated with the service account.

fields.name: metadata_server
fields.description: Prefix for a metadata server.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The GCP or AWS region in which to store data about the resource.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: A namespace identifier, such as a cluster name or environment.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the node within the namespace, such as hostname or IP address.

fields.name: job
fields.description: An identifier for a grouping of related task, such as the name of a microservice or distributed batch.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the task within the namespace and job, such as a replica index identifying the task within the job.

fields.name: export_to_project_id
fields.description: The GCP project that should receive these logs.
fields.default: Defaults to the project ID of the google\_service\_credentials file, or the project\_id from Google's metadata.google.internal server.

fields.name: resource
fields.description: Set resource type of data.

fields.name: k8s_cluster_name
fields.description: The name of the cluster that the container (node or pod based on the resource type) is running in.

fields.name: k8s_cluster_location
fields.description: The physical location of the cluster that contains (node or pod based on the resource type) the container.

fields.name: labels_key
fields.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to find the related labels from jsonPayload and then extract the value of it to set the LogEntry Labels.
fields.default: logging.googleapis.com/labels`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Optional list of comma separated of strings specifying key=value pairs.

fields.name: log_name_key
fields.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to extract logName from jsonPayload and set the logName field.
fields.default: logging.googleapis.com/logName`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

fields.name: tag_prefix
fields.description: Set the tag_prefix used to validate the tag of logs with k8s resource type.

fields.name: severity_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the key from the original record that contains the severity information.
fields.default: logging.googleapis.com/severity`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

fields.name: project_id_key
fields.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to find the gcp project id from jsonPayload and then extract the value of it to set the PROJECT_ID within LogEntry logName, which controls the gcp project that should receive these logs.
fields.default: logging.googleapis.com/projectId`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

fields.name: autoformat_stackdriver_trace
fields.description: Rewrite the trace field to include the projectID and format it for use with Cloud Trace.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: custom_k8s_regex
fields.description: Set a custom regex to extract field like pod_name, namespace_name, container_name and docker_id from the local_resource_id in logs.

fields.name: resource_labels
fields.description: An optional list of comma separated strings specifying resource labels plaintext assignments (new=value) and/or mappings from an original field in the log entry to a destination field (destination=$original).

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism.

fields.name: cloud_logging_base_url
fields.description: Set the base Cloud Logging API URL to use for the /v2/entries:write API request.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Stackdriver output plugin allows to ingest your records into Google Cloud Stackdriver Logging service.
